meta.title: Optimize billboard rendering for 3D particles with specialized batched render path
meta.body_summary: Copilot added a batched billboard rendering fast path with RenderStaticBillboards type for 3D particle systems, claiming performance benefits for hundreds/thousands of billboards.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added batched rendering fast path; maintainer closed immediately saying it was too sophisticated for Copilot to provide value.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 37 changed lines, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. However, it introduces a new RenderStaticBillboards type and fast-path API in a rendering engine, a change that the maintainer deemed too sophisticated for the agent to deliver value. The small size did not prevent closure due to perceived complexity mismatch.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer bryanedds closed the PR with a single comment stating the change is too sophisticated for Copilot to provide value for, indicating that the agent's contribution did not meet the maintainer's expectations for correctness or architecture.
review_details.performance_claim: Batched billboard rendering with fast path reduces per-billboard overhead for hundreds/thousands of particles, enabling efficient 3D particle systems.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer explicitly closed PR citing agent capability mismatch without requesting changes.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: 3D rendering engine optimization involves highly domain-specific knowledge and performance tradeoffs that the maintainer feels cannot be reliably implemented by Copilot, even for a small code addition.

detection_detail.code_reading: The maintainer assessed the proposed rendering changes and deemed them too sophisticated without detailed line-by-line review, indicating a high bar for agent contributions in the rendering subsystem.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after performance data provided; the PR body describes hypothetical benefits for many billboards.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer closed PR immediately without iteration, rejecting the contribution as a whole.

core_change_summary.description: Added RenderStaticBillboards type, a renderStaticBillboardFast API in WorldRender.fs, and handling in Renderer3d.fs/RendererProcess.fs to support batched billboard rendering with per-billboard color, blend mode, and flip options.
change_trajectory: Implementation commit adding RenderStaticBillboards and renderStaticBillboardFast; PR closed immediately by maintainer with comment about sophistication.

review_signals.summary: Maintainer stated the change is too sophisticated for Copilot to provide value for.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with batched rendering optimization.
Maintainer commented 'Too sophisticated for Copilot to provide value for.' and closed PR within ~30 minutes with no further discussion.
